_comment: Named market regimes for cross-period strategy evaluation. Edit windows here; run_regimes.py picks them up.

regimes.name: vol_2018
regimes.label: 2018 vol shocks
regimes.note: Feb volmageddon + Q4 fed-pivot panic. Tests strategies' behavior in sharp drawdowns inside a broader sideways tape.

regimes.name: covid_2020
regimes.label: 2020 COVID crash + V-recovery
regimes.note: March 35% crash then liquidity-driven V-shape. Stress test for regime detection / stops.

regimes.name: bull_2021
regimes.label: 2021 pure bull
regimes.note: Low-vol, broad bull. Trend/momentum should dominate; mean reversion should lag.

regimes.name: bear_2022
regimes.label: 2022 Fed bear
regimes.note: Tightening cycle, growth crash. Long-only strategies suffer; dual_momentum should rotate to bonds.

regimes.name: ai_2023_2024
regimes.label: 2023-2024 AI / mega-cap bull
regimes.note: Narrow leadership (Nvidia / mag-7). Momentum / breakout strategies should shine; low-vol may underperform.

regimes.name: recent_2025
regimes.label: 2025 → current
regimes.note: Year-to-date. Slot for the live regime. `end=null` -> use yesterday.
